card.name: Words just before a profession or equipment noun
card.fires_on: Small words like "a" or "of" (and sometimes a comma) right before an expected noun such as an occupation or a piece of equipment. Most often in the opioid asthma contraindication "in the absence of resuscitative equipment".

modes.label: Absence of equipment
modes.description: The word "of" after "in the absence" in the asthma contraindication, before "resuscitative equipment".
modes.example: Acute or severe bronchial asthma in an unmonitored setting or in the absence<< of>> resuscitative equipment [see Warnings

modes.label: Article before an occupation
modes.description: The word "a" after a name in a list, before a trade such as sword-maker or carpenter.

modes.label: Comma in a modifier list
modes.description: A comma between stacked adjectives or after an introductory phrase.
modes.example: A syndrome consisting of potentially irreversible<<,>> involuntary, dyskinetic movements may develop
